1. Why Blank Cost Drives 70% of Your POD Net Profit

In Print-on-Demand, retail prices on Etsy and Shopify are anchored by market expectations ($26–$34 for graphic tees, $44–$58 for hoodies). Because you cannot simply double your selling price, cutting your blank + print cost by $3–$5 per unit goes straight into your pocket.

2. Real Numbers: 80 Shirts/Month on Etsy US

At 80 orders/month ($33.99 total buyer paid), Printify Premium (~$12.95 blank+print+ship plus $29/mo subscription) typically nets ~$425+/month MORE profit than Printful (~$18.65 equivalent)—an extra $5,100+ per year for the exact same designs and traffic.
